title: Templates, scripts, automation, recovery and retry: every piece is scripted from a template, restarts from its files, retries a bounded number of times and no agent drives it
text: Owner, 2026-10-11 18:33Z: 'All that shit you create better be automated and no agent needs to drive it.' 'Templates, scripts, automation, recovery and retry logic is awesome.' Binding: bringup starts it, recover restarts it, a bounded retry (attempt 1 to 3) precedes a 423, failure is a record and a notification, and the owner never asks an agent to kick it.
